releaseNotes: Device Scene/HMI engineering is promoted with stable EDIT/RUN separation, read-only SSOT visualization, protected property-save behavior, reliable marquee multi-selection, dual-side workspace focus, and 9-segment Signal Tower rendering driven by the active Runtime preset.

ICEops AI Fast and Expert modes now share the same evidence pipeline. Specialist agents use bounded read-only historical evidence where applicable, while selected-Port analysis recursively removes cross-Port evidence before the existing scope guard validates the request.

The reported Oscilloscope case where a Port 1 request could include Port 8 evidence is corrected at the evidence-source filtering layer; the scope guard remains strict so future cross-Port leakage is still blocked rather than hidden.

Communication, polling, MAX governor, network recovery, PDO/ISDU transport, PdoOutputCoordinator, Studio Runtime execution, Signal Tower output arbitration, device identification, IODD auto-mapping, and safe-disconnect paths are unchanged.

en: Device Scene/HMI is promoted with stable EDIT/RUN separation, read-only SSOT visualization, reliable marquee selection, dual-side workspace focus, and active-preset-driven 9-segment Signal Tower rendering.
AI Fast and Expert modes now share one evidence pipeline, and specialist agents use bounded read-only historical evidence where applicable.

Selected-Port analysis now removes cross-Port specialist evidence before the existing strict scope guard validates the request; the reported Port 1 / Port 8 Oscilloscope mismatch is corrected at its source.
Communication, Runtime, PDO/ISDU transport, polling/MAX, recovery, identification, IODD mapping, and Signal Tower output-control paths are unchanged.
ko: Device Scene/HMI는 안정화된 EDIT/RUN 분리, Read-Only SSOT 시각화, 영역 다중선택, 양쪽 패널 확장, 실제 활성 프리셋 기반 9-Segment Signal Tower 표시를 포함해 정식 승격됩니다.
AI Fast와 Expert 모드는 동일한 Evidence Pipeline을 사용하며, 전문 Agent는 필요한 경우 기존 Read-Only 이력 DB Evidence를 제한된 범위로 사용합니다.
선택 Port 분석은 기존 Scope Guard 검증 전에 전문 Evidence 내부의 타 Port 데이터를 재귀적으로 제거합니다. 보고된 Port 1 요청에 Port 8 Oscilloscope Evidence가 섞이던 문제를 발생 지점에서 수정했습니다.
통신, Runtime, PDO/ISDU Transport, Polling/MAX, Network Recovery, Device Identification, IODD Mapping, Signal Tower 실제 Output Control 경로는 변경하지 않았습니다.
ja: Device Scene/HMI は、安定した EDIT/RUN 分離、Read-Only SSOT 可視化、マーキー複数選択、左右パネル拡張、実際のアクティブ preset に基づく 9-Segment Signal Tower 表示を含めて正式昇格します。
AI Fast と Expert は同一の Evidence Pipeline を使用し、専門 Agent は必要な場合に既存の Read-Only 履歴 DB Evidence を限定範囲で使用します。
選択 Port 分析では、既存 Scope Guard の検証前に専門 Evidence 内の他 Port データを再帰的に除外します。Port 1 の要求に Port 8 Oscilloscope Evidence が混在する問題を発生源で修正しました。
通信、Runtime、PDO/ISDU Transport、Polling/MAX、Network Recovery、Device Identification、IODD Mapping、Signal Tower の実 Output Control 経路は変更していません。
zh-CN: Device Scene/HMI 正式升级，包含稳定的 EDIT/RUN 分离、只读 SSOT 可视化、框选多选、左右面板扩展，以及由实际活动 preset 驱动的 9-Segment Signal Tower 显示。
AI Fast 与 Expert 模式现在共用同一 Evidence Pipeline；专业 Agent 在需要时通过现有只读路径使用受范围限制的历史 DB Evidence。
选定 Port 的分析会在现有严格 Scope Guard 校验前递归移除专业 Evidence 中其他 Port 的数据，从源头修复 Port 1 请求混入 Port 8 Oscilloscope Evidence 的问题。
通信、Runtime、PDO/ISDU Transport、Polling/MAX、Network Recovery、Device Identification、IODD Mapping 与 Signal Tower 实际输出控制路径均未修改。
de: Device Scene/HMI wird mit stabiler EDIT/RUN-Trennung, schreibgeschützter SSOT-Visualisierung, zuverlässiger Mehrfachauswahl, beidseitiger Workspace-Erweiterung und einer vom aktiven Preset gesteuerten 9-Segment-Signalturm-Darstellung freigegeben.
AI Fast und Expert verwenden dieselbe Evidence-Pipeline; spezialisierte Agents nutzen bei Bedarf begrenzte historische DB-Evidence über den vorhandenen Read-Only-Pfad.

Bei einer Analyse eines ausgewählten Ports werden fremde Port-Daten rekursiv aus Specialist-Evidence entfernt, bevor der bestehende strikte Scope Guard validiert. Damit ist der gemeldete Port-1/Port-8-Oszilloskop-Konflikt an der Quelle behoben.
Kommunikation, Runtime, PDO/ISDU-Transport, Polling/MAX, Network Recovery, Device Identification, IODD Mapping und die reale Signal-Tower-Ausgabesteuerung bleiben unverändert.
es: Device Scene/HMI se promociona con separación EDIT/RUN estable, visualización SSOT de solo lectura, selección múltiple por marco, expansión bilateral del workspace y Signal Tower de 9 segmentos gobernado por el preset activo real.
AI Fast y Expert comparten ahora el mismo Evidence Pipeline; los agentes especializados usan evidencia histórica de base de datos, limitada y de solo lectura, cuando corresponde.

El análisis de un Port seleccionado elimina recursivamente datos de otros Ports dentro de la evidencia especializada antes de la validación del Scope Guard existente. Así se corrige en el origen la mezcla Port 1 / Port 8 observada en Oscilloscope.
Las rutas de comunicación, Runtime, transporte PDO/ISDU, Polling/MAX, Network Recovery, Device Identification, IODD Mapping y control real de salida del Signal Tower no se modificaron.
